title: 銀色の街の、白い煙の記憶
author: 鏡 ミライ

en.title: Memories of White Smoke in the Silver City
en.premise: In a world where people digitize unnecessary memories and overwhelming sorrows to discard them aboard the annual 'Final Train,' one station attendant plays a special role. By listening to the 'small regrets' passengers wish to leave behind, he helps them find the strength to move forward. In an efficient digital society, this is a story about the ritual of forgetting, carried out by the intentionally inconvenient grace of a steam engine.

zh.title: 银色之城的白烟记忆
zh.premise: 人们将不再需要的记忆或无法承受的悲伤数字化，通过一年一度的“最终列车”将其丢弃。而身为车站职员的主角，则负责倾听乘客们想要舍弃的那些“小小遗憾”，并送别他们，引导他们重新向前迈进。在高效的数字化社会中，这是一个关于由刻意保留的、不便的蒸汽机所承载的“遗忘”仪式的故事。
